name: Alexander Kolodin
summary:
Alexander Kolodin (born June 30, 1986) is an American lawyer and politician serving in the Arizona House of Representatives since 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party, and was the party's nominee for the 2026 Arizona Secretary of State election, losing to incumbent Democrat Adrian Fontes.
Prior to joining the state legislature, Kolodin worked as an attorney representing plaintiffs in lawsuits to overturn the 2020 presidential election results in Arizona.
